availablePortRange.description: Range of unused ports available on the SSH Proxy endpoint to be used for Jumpbox port forwarding

daysToKeepOperationalLogs.description: The number of days to store SSH proxy logs before they are rolled over

enablePasswordHiding.description: Enable to hide passwords from SSH keystroke capture. This prevents logging user input on lines that are determined to be a password prompt.

enableProxyBlockListing.description: Enable block listing of IP Addresses that connect and fail to authenticate too many times

enableProxyInactivityTimeout.description: Whether or not the proxy should disconnect inactive sessions

enableSshProxy.description: Whether or not the SSH proxy is enabled

enableSshPublicKeyAuth.description: Whether or not the SSH Terminal can allow key authentication

enableSshTerminal.description: Whether or not the SSH terminal is enabled

enableSshTunneling.description: Whether or not to allow SSH tunneling through the proxy for proxied RDP sessions

enableTerminalInactivityTimeout.description: Whether or not the SSH terminal should disconnect inactive sessions

enableWindowTitleChangeCommand.description: Send window title change command on startup

passwordRegexFilter.description: Regular Expression used to identify password prompts. The default expression search for either prompts beginning with 'sudo password for' or prompts ending with 'password:'

proxyAutoBlockListingMaxHistory.description: The number of history entries to keep per client

proxyAutoBlockListingMaxNum.description: The number of failed authentication attempts before being blocked

proxyAutoBlockListingTimeFrameMinutes.description: The time frame in which all the failed attempts must happen before being blocked

proxyInactivityTimeoutSeconds.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait before disconnecting inactive proxy sessions

proxyNewSecretsByDefault.description: Whether or not new SSH-enabled secrets should be created with 'Proxy Enabled' set

sshHostKey.description: The host key that will the proxy will serve

sshProxyBanner.description: The banner that is display when someone opens an shell connection to the proxy

sshProxyHostFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the host key that the proxy will serve

sshProxyPort.description: The port that that SSH proxy runs on

sshTerminalBanner.description: The banner that is displayed when someone authenticates to the SSH terminal

terminalInactivityTimeoutSeconds.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait before disconnecting inactive terminal sessions

tunnelKeepAliveInSeconds.description: Keep alive signals to local port forwarding tunnels at this interval (in seconds). Prevents port forwarding tunnels from closing. (0-86400)
